task: HIS-v0 — explicit-structure third-order interaction constraint, seed-0 exploratory screen
hypothesis: The pure third-order interaction response of the explicit 2-hop path-code table is under-constrained at 10k molecule-level labels; a low-order-preferring statistical regulariser on that response may improve generalisation to unseen local compositions.

design.object: effective linear response of LocalContent.path_emb on the first LocalContent MLP layer
design.input_block_proof: his_cpu_checks G2: a random perturbation of path_emb changes exactly input columns 320..351 and the layer-0 output delta equals dx[:,320:352] @ W[:,320:352].T
design.anova: balanced ANOVA over the three categorical axes; H_le2 = AB + AC + BC - (A + B + C) + mu ; H_3 = H - H_le2
design.anova_formula_note: The task brief prints H - A - B - C + AB + AC + BC - mu, which is not the residual (it does not annihilate first/second-order tensors and its marginals are non-zero). The implemented H_3 is the unique residual satisfying the four properties the same brief requires; the discrepancy is pinned by tests/test_his_v0.py::test_literal_brief_formula_is_not_the_residual.
not_penalised: any parameter outside path_emb.weight and mlp.lins.0.weight[:, 320:352]
design.rescaling_invariance: penalty(E, W) = penalty(cE, W/c); checked in his_cpu_checks G4

his.lambda_rule: lambda = 0.10 * ||g_L1|| / ||g_reg|| over the affected parameters (path_emb.weight + the 32 W_path columns)

lambda_guards.action_if_violated: stop and report; do not switch calibration method

his.calibration_batch: first 128 rows of seed-0 epoch-1 data order (torch.randperm(10000, Generator(101)))

lambda_freeze.calibrated_on: res (NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB, driver 550.163.01, torch 2.5.1+cu124), pool res-gpu0
lambda_freeze.reproducibility: 3 identical repeats in-process (max rel dev 0.0); identical to the CPU preview to 7 significant digits

data.source: official PyG ZINC subset=True train 10000 / valid 1000 (test never constructed)
data.cache_identity_rule: The content_sha256 is the gating invariant. The torch.save container file sha256 differs between checkouts that stored identical tensors (zip member ordering/timestamps); both copies exist and carry the same content fingerprint. File sha256 is recorded for provenance only.

recipe.checkpoint_selection: strict argmin official-valid MAE, ties -> earlier epoch

arms.REPLAY: lambda = 0; the penalty term is not constructed at all (bit-identical loss graph to the frozen trainer)
arms.HIS: lambda = frozen calibrated value; loss = L1 + lambda * mean(H_3**2)

worst10_source: tracks/structural-sufficiency/zinc_cjp_ssl_v1/configs/cjp_ssl_v1.json diagnostic_rows.historical_lca_s0_worst10 (frozen before that round's GPU results)

verdict_rules.delta_sign: delta = HIS - REPLAY on per-molecule absolute error; negative = HIS better
GREEN: all_minus_row172 and all_minus_worst10 both still improve
AMBER: not driven by a single extreme row
verdict_rules.RED: neither of the above, or the regulariser is not measurably active in the trained model
verdict_rules.CPU_STOP: Phase A correctness failure or either Phase A materiality threshold not met

test_policy: terminal; the official test split must not be constructed, loaded or scored in this round

history_anchors.note: historical only; the primary comparison is this round's synchronised REPLAY_s0 vs HIS_s0
